summary: The evidence verifier checks input values, not only their presence: input_order holds a note's value to the run's own (passed with --run-input), and shard_inputs requires every shard of a sharded note to be a success; fractal-web's policy checks its shard inputs (one shard on pull requests), and scripts/evidence-flip-ready does not propose fractal-web's flip until its kit_inputs order is in the policy too

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. The skip policy gains two optional kind keys; fractal-web stays shadow (enforce false).

compatibility.detail: Policies without the new keys behave as before; evidence-verify gains --run-input. Existing fractal-web notes carry one shard, all success.
